magellan-elcano-circumnavigation: Of five ships and about 270 men, one ship and 18 men return to Spain after the first voyage around the world.
rampjaar-the-disaster-year: France, England, Münster and Cologne attack the Republic at once; the De Witt brothers are lynched in The Hague.
german-empire-proclaimed: Wilhelm I is proclaimed German Emperor in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles.
nobel-prize-in-chemistry: Curie becomes the first person to win two Nobel Prizes, and still the only one in two different sciences.
khmer-rouge-regime: Pol Pot's regime empties the cities; an estimated 1.5–2 million Cambodians die.
